name: Aid

header.Components: V, S, M (a strip of white cloth)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Choose up to three creatures; increase current and maximum HP together for eight hours; add 5 HP per higher slot; same spell does not stack.

rules.text: Choose up to three creatures within range.
Each target’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.
Each target’s Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

definition.name: Aid
definition.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Each target’s Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

required_extensions.requirement: Bind each chosen recipient, formula, recurring benefit and ending to the exact cast; self-only source carriers do not supply arbitrary recipients or every benefit kind.
required_extensions.spell_specific_intent: Choose up to three creatures; increase current and maximum HP together for eight hours; add 5 HP per higher slot; same spell does not stack.

required_extensions.requirement: The base fixed max_hp_source can be written today. The shared upcast contract has no slot-scaled max-HP amount; add 5 to both current/max HP per paid slot above 2 without weakening ownership/nonstacking.
